Question 9

Find the function f(x) and the value of b, given that ∫ebf(x)dx=limn→∞∑i=0n−1[ln⁡(e+ien)⋅en].

a
 f(x)=ln⁡(x+e) and b=e2
b
 f(x)=ln⁡(x+e) and b=e+1
c
 f(x)=ln⁡x and b=e2
d
 f(x)=ln⁡(x+e) and b=2e
e
 f(x)=ln⁡x and b=2e
